steps.speaker: Weary Shadow
steps.content: That's not the right direction... You're wrong... We're all wrong...
A shadow leans feebly against a door that feels painfully familiar.
Old and weary, he is the last keeper of the ship, guarding the door with pointless determination.

steps.speaker: Weary Shadow
steps.content: ...This intuition... it's saved me many times... Trust me... we can't walk to our doom like this...
As you draw closer, the shadow's neck suddenly bursts open, gushing liquid darkness.
He spins around, mustering his last strength to grab something, and lunges at you on pure reflex.
But when he sees what's before him, you feel the crushing shock and despair from the depths of his soul, even though his features are obscured.

steps.speaker: Weary Shadow
steps.content: Why... you... What do you... want to do?!
Life drains from him. He collapses in exhaustion, his body dissolving.

steps.speaker: Weary Shadow
steps.content: Whatever... None of it matters anymore...

steps.speaker: Weary Shadow
steps.content: There's nothing left on this ship... worth staying for...
The shadow vanishes without another sound. The path forward is now clear.
